# CareerOS — Copilot Repository Instructions

Before coding, read `AI_TAKEOVER.md` and inspect the exact active branch/commit named by the current handover record. Do not assume `main` is the active development branch.

CareerOS is an existing AI-powered Global Career Operating System. Extend and repair; do not rebuild. Preserve frozen v0.1. Current v0.2 delivery is profile-first: Profile Builder → CV + Professional Document Vault → Profile Intelligence → Personas → Global Job Discovery → later application/interview/analytics modules.

Keep CV intake separate from the Professional Document Vault. Keep application settings separate from profile data. Vertical navigation is domain-level; horizontal navigation is contextual and must not duplicate it. Preserve the evidence/provenance model and user confirmation of extracted career facts.

Never commit secrets or OAuth credentials. Never modify applied migrations. Never fabricate career/job/company/immigration facts. Never claim tests or verification without actually running them. Use versioned branches and backups. Record blockers and update the persistent AI handover state before stopping.

The detailed current handover is on `working/m02-profile-builder-v1.3-20260902` under `docs/AI_TAKEOVER/`. The live-interview branch is known to be stale/diverged and must be reconciled before integration.
